q: The communication complexity of computing the inner product function IP(x,y) = Σxᵢyᵢ (mod 2) over GF(2) for two n-bit strings requires Alice and Bob to exchange:
exp: IP has randomised communication complexity Θ(n): any protocol (deterministic or randomised) computing IP with error ≤ 1/3 requires Ω(n) bits. This is proven using the rank lower bound and the fact that the communication matrix of IP (sign matrix of inner product) has rank 2^n.
